name: facebook-comment-reply
title: Facebook Comment Reply
description: Reply to comments on Facebook posts using Playwright browser automation

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: scrape = extract comments, reply = post a comment. Auto-detected if empty.

commentId.title: Comment ID (reply mode)
commentId.description: ID of a specific comment to reply to

replyMessage.title: Reply Message (reply mode)
replyMessage.description: The text to post as a comment/reply. If empty, switches to scrape mode.

cookies.title: Facebook Cookies
cookies.description: Facebook session cookies as JSON array
